sources.title: Statement on Fair Value Measurement and Disclosure Considerations for Private Assets
sources.review_scope: Official SEC page dated September 28, 2026, with bylines Kurt Hohl (Chief Accountant) and Brian Daly (Director, Division of Investment Management). Footnote 1 identifies the authors' staff views: the Commission has neither approved nor disapproved the content; it carries no legal force and creates no new obligations. This is staff guidance, not an issued standard or Commission rule. The page discusses private-asset fair-value and disclosure considerations and refers to ASC 820/946 and PCAOB AS 2501/1105. Only page identity, date, bylines and status were recorded. No source body, operation permission, applicability conclusion, professional review or original-article association is supplied.
